body.statement: For every \(N\ge1\), every \(p\in\Omega_H\), and every circuit return, \(\Pr_p\{\operatorname{Eval}(F,p)\in\mathcal I_N(F)\}\ge1-\alpha\). The guarantee holds without selecting one empirical branch and remains valid at intersections of equality guards; any certified outer approximation to \(\mathcal I_N(F)\) inherits the same coverage.
body.justification: Guard intersections are statistically nonregular, so honest inference must propagate uncertainty through all near-compatible branches rather than condition on a selected formula.
body.gap: FangSantos2019DirectionalInference treats directionally differentiable maps, while the present region exploits finite multinomial concentration and certified guard coverage for a union of graphical model images.
body.consumer: Applied users obtain a valid finite-sample target region when empirical ALARM cell frequencies lie near a structural or formula-agreement boundary.
